notes: NEGATIVE RESULT, and it gates the cache-backed tar-layer prototype. In-process gzip of the exact official tar does not reproduce the official .app.tar.gz. Four backends (zlib-rs 0.6.7, zlib-rs 0.6.3, system zlib, miniz_oxide 0.8.9) all produced an identical 4070510-byte candidate differing from the 4070756-byte official at byte 47, 37 bytes into the DEFLATE stream; the 10-byte gzip header matches. Because four independent implementations agree with each other and all fall 246 bytes short, the cause is the write/flush pattern into the encoder, not the encoder. The controlled tar-layer experiment achieved exact recompression only by running the cargo-tauri binary over an extracted tree, which a shipped plugin cannot do. The mechanism (tar::Builder streaming into GzEncoder) is a HYPOTHESIS: tauri-bundler source is not vendored here and was not read.
